newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct in quiet trade.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.04 percent to close at 1.0433 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market in calm trading ahead of Monday's Martin Luther King Day holiday in the United States, dealers said.
Dealers expected a net dollar surplus today. Preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a Friday surplus of $45 million.
Despite an in-flow of dollars, players bought dollars because Monday's holiday meant they would have no carry-over cost to hold greenbacks over the weekend, they said.
Because of the holiday, today's transactions will be settled on Wednesday, together with Monday's transactions, they added.
Traders expected an another calm trade session on Monday.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real dropped 0.03 percent to close at 1.0485 per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.45 percent to end at 1.095 per greenback, traders said.
